title: Fly Half Read The Defence Choose (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl steel guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the fly half is the general
Read the defence in two seconds, choose
Kick, pass, or run, three options every play

[Verse 1]
Receive the ball from the nine flat or deep
Look up before you catch, the read is the keep
Where is the space, where is the press
Which runner is open, which option to bless

[Pre-Chorus]
If the defence is up fast, kick over the top
If the defence is back, pass wide, run nonstop
If the defence has a gap, run straight through
Three decisions in a heartbeat, son, the brew

[Chorus]
Fly half read the defence choose, son
Kick, pass, or run, the work begun
Two seconds to decide, then commit
The ten is the brain, never quit

[Verse 2]
Flat ball to the centre cuts the line
Deep ball to the wing finds the corner fine
Cross kick to the wing if the touchline is open
Grubber behind the line if the defenders are bopen

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the ten reads the field
Like a chess player, the moves are revealed
Three moves ahead, never two
Great fly halves see the play before they do

[Chorus]
Fly half read the defence choose, son
Kick, pass, or run, the work begun
Two seconds to decide, then commit
The ten is the brain, never quit

[Outro]
Read, decide, commit
Kick, pass, or run, dont split
Two second decision, three moves ahead
Thats my boy, the ten well read
